items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: “Jumpin’ the Blues” and “Sepian Bounce” with McShann.

ctx.x: But apart from “Jumpin’ Blues,” what other Charlie Parker solos did you learn...
“Jumpin’ the Blues” and “Sepian Bounce” with McShann. A couple of more tunes. But all of them were with McShann.
Everything with McShann. So your experience with Charlie Parker...
